notes.note: Scoped prerequisite impact review: inspected the new development-guide paragraph against node-pty group cleanup and the executed macOS PTY tests. POSIX census support is required and missing census must fail cleanup; this does not add a package dependency, change shared child-workload launch APIs, implement supervisor survival, change test-resource policy, or qualify Windows/native/other POSIX hosts. Existing source/verification routing remains accurate. This records documentation impact only, not independent review or release approval.
